display_long_description:
Facility Apes 3 is a multiplayer VR Backrooms experience with 61 levels to explore, escape, and survive.

Travel through 55 main levels, five hidden branch levels, and Threshold. Each level has its own environment, puzzles, entities, secrets, and challenges. Explore recognizable locations like Level 0 and the Poolrooms alongside many original levels such as Terror Hotel, Grass Rooms, The Bunker Springs, Circus, Soundless Solitude, Red Forest, DinnerParty, and Thalassophobia.

Play alone or team up with up to six players. Create your own game, join other players through public lobbies Work together, solve puzzles, avoid dangerous entities, and try to reach the end.

Enter the Backrooms now and see if you can complete all 61 levels.
